name: @sos-2/decision
description: SOS 2.0 Decision Engine (Work Order W10): evaluate(request) -> DecisionRecord where the outcome is EXACTLY one of the frozen six (ACT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE, ASK, REJECT, ROLLBACK — consumed from @sos-2/authority's DECISION_ACTIONS, never redefined). Typed decision inputs: proposed action, evidence set, authority grants, uncertainty, impact, risk, reversibility, blast radius. Every DecisionRecord is REPRODUCIBLE: it carries the exact input digest (canonical hash over the request) and the ordered rule trace; re-evaluation of the same input yields the byte-identical record. Rule ordering is explicit and deterministic — authority first, then safety, then evidence (then uncertainty). Authority and the risk x irreversibility matrix are delegated to @sos-2/autonomy (the W10 autonomy policy); evidence classification and freshness to @sos-2/evidence (the merged W3 authority). Confidence is carried but NEVER consulted for authorization (spec/architecture.md sections 3, 5, 18; spec/requirements.md R15, R16, R30; spec/architecture-lock.md).
